title: Vendor Metric Provenance
description: Experimental (media_buy.measurement_provenance). Provenance for one `vendor_metric_values[]` row of the same `delivery-metrics.json` object, joined on `(vendor, metric_id, qualifier)`: which collection mechanisms built the value and whether the vendor deduplicated across them (not `measurement_source`, which names the provider). It is a sibling array rather than a field on the row because `vendor-metric-value.json` is a closed row envelope (DR-0019, DR-0036). The join key is the row's own key: `vendor` and `metric_id` match the row's, and `qualifier` MUST be present exactly when the row's qualifier is, with the identical value. An entry that matches no row is ignored. At most one entry per key; a seller MUST NOT emit two. It does not partition rows and is not a `qualifier` key, so it stays out of the `(vendor, metric_id, qualifier)` reconciliation join. When no entry matches a row, provenance is unspecified, never an implicit source; see the vendor's `methodology_url`. Open per DR-0009; vendor-specific detail belongs in the row's `breakdown`.

vendor.description: Vendor of the row this entry describes. Matches the row's `vendor`.

metric_id.description: Metric of the row this entry describes. Matches the row's `metric_id`.

qualifier.description: The row's `qualifier`, repeated verbatim when the row carries one, so provenance joins on `(vendor, metric_id, qualifier)`. Omit when the row has none.

mechanisms.description: Mechanisms whose events enter the row's value; not every mechanism the vendor operates, and not cross-check mechanisms. `mechanisms` is the union across the row's aggregation scope. A set: order carries no meaning and values MUST NOT repeat.

deduplicated.description: Whether the vendor deduplicated across all feeds behind the listed `mechanisms` (if only some, omit and describe in the methodology). `false` means a simple union, so overlap may be double-counted; senders MUST serialize an explicit `false`. Absent means unspecified, never `false`. SHOULD be omitted for a single feed. Says nothing about dedup level (household, person, device).
